notes.title: Bone Dust 1.0 Release Soon
notes.notes:
Hi!

We have been busy going through all the feedback you have provided. Thank you! Your help has been paramount to the development of Bone Dust.

We are now preparing to release version 1.0 of Bone Dust. Planned release date is 20.4.2023.

Version 1.0 includes new and improved level with new bullet patterns and enemy placements. And it also includes paid leaderboard. The game remains free to play but if you want to put your name into the leaderboard, it costs you one coin (one coin costs approx. 0.20€).

Important: We will erase current early access leaderboard before the release of version 1.0 on 20.4.2023!

So if you want to take screeshots etc. now is the time.

Keep the feedback coming. This is just the beginning of the Bone Dust -saga!

- Bone Dust dev team
